messages:
neha (people-ops): small deliverable for review: 'Mini goal kit' 1-line self-review prompts + 2 manager coaching shells + a peer ask. keeping it ultra copyable.

devin (eng): can we get samples that map to both product and infra work? eng folks always ask which KR counts.

neha (people-ops): yes 1 sample for each: product, infra, and growth. use whichever fits.

neha (people-ops): Product sample:
`Focus: Launch multi-tenant inference route to support 3 customers`
`Evidence: Deployed route, onboarded 2 customers, reduced onboarding time 30% (see runbook)`
`Next: Complete telemetry for SLA and add 1 canary customer`

neha (people-ops): Infra sample:
`Focus: Reduce steady-state GPU cost by 25% via autoscaling & quantization`
`Evidence: Autoscale policy cut cluster hours by 18% in weeklies; quantized model v1 lowered mem by 40%`
`Next: Expand autoscale to burst pools and validate accuracy at 95% confidence`

neha (people-ops): Growth/career sample:
`Focus: Improve cross-team collaboration and code review quality`
`Evidence: Ran 3 design sessions, mentored 1 peer into IC2, reduced PR rework by 15%`
`Next: Lead a shared retro and publish best-practices doc`

roxana (manager): these are great. could we get a one-liner managers can paste into DM nudges for late self-reviews?

neha (people-ops): sure: `Quick nudge: Hi <name> 1 friendly reminder to fill your self-review by Friday so I can include it in calibration. 1-2 bullets: focus, one evidence link, next step.`

tim (pm): any advice for peer feedback asks when people worry about sounding too critical?

neha (people-ops): recommend this: `Hi <name>, could you share 1 thing I did well and 1 thing I could improve? Keep it specific (1 sentence each) and constructive (suggested next step). Thanks!`

devin (eng): nit: can we add a line that says "paste evidence links" to every template? reviewers skip often.

neha (people-ops): good call. updated note: `Add Evidence links: <dashboard/PR/Runbook>` to each self-review bullet.

people-bot: Reminder queued 1 automated DM to managers on 1935001200 and daily nudges at 09:30 for 3 days. :bell:

roxana (manager): thanks team. i'll forward the kit to my team and include the evidence link prompt. small ask: can people-ops provide a printable cheat-sheet next week?

neha (people-ops): will do 1 aim to deliver a single-page PDF with paste-ready snippets and a checklist by Wed.

devin (eng): saved, will use infra sample for my review.

roxana (manager): closing loop: please add a short line to the manager shell about moderating praise vs stretch objectives so calibration stays fair.

neha (people-ops): noted, i'll add a 1-sentence calibration tip: `Managers: call out baseline vs stretch in your notes and link evidence to avoid inflation.`
